    $idx

    $folderPath

    $($files.Count) files
      $fileItems
    "@ } $html = @" StudentManager - Cấu trúc thư mục & file

    StudentManager

    Cấu trúc folder & file — WinForms C# (.NET Framework 4.0)

    $totalFolders folders $totalFiles files Loại trừ: obj, bin

    $nav

    Chú thích loại file

    .cs .Designer.cs .resx .png / .gif / .ico .xsd / .xsc / .xss .csproj
    $sections
    Generated $(Get-Date -Format 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') — StudentManager Project Structure
    "@ $html | Out-File -FilePath "g:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL\check-test\StudentManager-structure.html" -Encoding UTF8 Write-Output "Done: StudentManager-structure.html"
